result.quote: We are ready to kill him on the way.
result.reason: The key reasonably paraphrases the intended plan: they would kill Paul while he was being brought to the council. However, the question has an inaccurate premise because the window says more than forty men, not exactly 40, and they spoke to the chief priests and elders. Revise to: “What plan did more than forty men present to the chief priests and elders?” This preserves the intended answer scope.
